parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. e.g. a more detailed description of {{param|Type}}.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Current value representing the {{object}}; MUST be an element of {{param|ValidValues}}.

parameters.name: ValidValues
parameters.description: List of valid values from the control represented by the {{object}}.

object.description: The EnumControl reflects the Enumerated level Control functionality. The enumeration is defined by the {{param|ValidValues}} parameter. This will provide a comma-separated list of values that are available for configuring via the {{param|Value}} parameter.
